Commentary.Commentary: We are ready for Zimbabwe to begin their reply with their first innings. Joylord Gumbie and Ben Curran walk out as the openers for Zimbabwe. Yamin Ahmadzai will bowl the first over for Afghanistan.
... SECOND INNINGS ...

Afghanistan on the other hand, will be very disappointed. Just the one batter got past the 20-run mark and that was Rashid Khan. The others struggled to cope with the bounce and movement on the surface. They have now been bundled out for a below par score and will need their bowlers to step up. The hosts on the other hand, will hope they can bat similar to the way they did in the first Test. Stay tuned for their reply.

The openers did get off to a start but once that stand was broken, they kept losing wickets at regular intervals. All the bowlers got a wicket at least but the picks were Raza and Nyamhuri. They got important wickets for their side.
That’s a fine, fine performance by Zimbabwe with the ball and their skipper’s decision to bowl first has been justified!

Shahidi and Shah though have begun well, Zimbabwe would know what these two can do and would be eager to break this stand quickly. Afghanistan on the other hand will want these two to put up another big partnership. Stay tuned for the last session.

Have to say Zimbabwe will be really happy with how this session has panned out! It began though really well for the visitors as their openers batted really well and managed to score quite freely. They though fell in quick succession and since then, Zimbabwe have been really good with the ball. They have kept it tight and made it tough for the batters to score runs.

TOSS - ZIMBABWE HAVE WON THE TOSS AND ELECTED TO FIELD!
We have some excellent news! The toss is expected to take place at (1100 GMT) and the game to begin half an hour after that. Hopefully the rain now stays away and we get some cricket in.

UPDATE - (1008 GMT) - So, we have had no action in the first session! However, signs are good for the second as it is bright and sunny and the covers are off too. The umpires are having a look out in the middle. Fingers crossed. We hope we get some action after Lunch!
There's a big discussion going on between the groundsmen right beside the wicket which the game is going to be played on. There are some damp areas near the wicket and they aren't happy about it.

UPDATE - (0821 GMT) - The cover on the pitch is still on and there's no movement from the groundsmen now. They maybe expecting some more rain. Just as we write that, the groundsmen are making their way out to the middle and all the covers are coming off now. It is a lot brighter too but there are a few wet patches down there and that might be a cause of concern.
UPDATE - (0805 GMT) - It's a lot brighter now and the groundsmen have also entered the field! Also, the covers seem to being peeled off slowly. This is GOOD NEWS!
Not the best of news to begin with! There was a lot of rain last night and this morning and the TOSS HAS BEEN DELAYED! It isn't raining but the outfield is not ready as of now.

A draw in the first Test means, this one is the decider. The winner takes it all. Saying that, we are playing on the same venue as the first one. It was a slow, placid wicket and hence, the first game was quite dull. We dearly hope this time around the contest between bat and ball is a lot more even. Also, there is rain predicted but we hope that it stays away. This being the last game of this tour, we hope for a cracker. Stay tuned.
